column2: Content blocks arrange text/images consistently; they do not falsify sources, rename viewers or create an ISP server. Correct visual-authoring function.
Insert Maps embeds a geographic location; sound, memory and account passwords are not the relevant site component.
Duplicating an object creates a similar editable copy; not deletion, conversion to audio or denial of viewer access.
Undo reverses a previous undoable edit; redo reapplies it when available. It is not publication, client-disk backup or domain renaming.
Public contact/copyright information is suitable in a school footer; secrets, unpublished scores/private profiles and banking PINs are inappropriate disclosure.
Insert YouTube is the integrated YouTube embed tool; Maps/divider/contents do not select the requested video. Actual availability still depends on video permissions.
Selecting the image and dragging its resize handle is the appropriate editor operation; account changes/deleting pages/disabling preview are not resizing.
Related topical content belongs in coherent body regions, not ordering by credentials, fan speed or router capacity.
A wrong map marker needs the selected location corrected; color/font/project filename do not change geographic coordinates.
Redo restores a just-undone operation if the edit history supports it; does not publish, rewrite all links or skip access checks.
An editor must check accurate, consistent contact data; footer placement does not automatically validate phone/address values or grant viewers write access.
True: Sites includes a YouTube insertion tool; not a promise every private/prohibited video can be embedded.
True: checking/updating/footer publication prevents stale contact information in the displayed version.
False: changing the Google account name cannot reverse a content-block deletion; undo is the relevant editing history operation.
False: undo reverses an edit rather than publishing the draft's changes.
The Pages tab organizes pages; Insert adds content, Themes styles it and Maps inserts a resource. UI terminology is textbook-version scoped.
Pages plus New page is the book's add-page sequence; deleting accounts, installing printers and replacing memory are unrelated.
Activating a linked image follows its assigned destination; it does not change file format, increase pixels or erase child pages.
Navigation comprises page/group links, not passwords, visitor MAC lists or power supplies.
Child pages normally elaborate a related content grouping; unlike the distractors they need not be unrelated, credential stores or replace the home page.
Select the intended text, then apply a destination link; deletion, sound conversion and wholesale table conversion are not link-creation prerequisites.
Sites can update navigation from its page tree while permitting adjustments/hiding; the qualified 'supports' avoids claiming every new page must remain visible.
Choose the intended internal destination page; owner's password, display resolution and unrelated images are not link targets for that requirement.
Label/destination mismatch is the navigation defect; typography/pixel count do not fix an incorrect address.
Menu and body links can fail independently and both need testing; automatic menu updates do not validate every manually inserted link.
Renaming can require checking labels/references; it does not require changing users' power supplies, keyboards or printer firmware. 'Can' does not assume Sites always breaks its internal IDs.
False: unrelated grouping makes a child harder to find and contradicts meaningful information architecture.
True: verify labels and destinations after renaming even if some internal references update automatically.
True: a coherent tree helps organize content and navigation together.
False: body links/labels still need testing after automatic menu updates.
One satisfaction level is an exclusive selection; an essay, movie upload and paper drawing need other input types. Correct one-choice example.
Insert Forms embeds the selected form in Sites; Maps/contents/divider are distinct components. Textbook p148 confirms the named control.
Responses shows submitted answers in summary/individual views; it does not restyle the site, power a client or convert file types.
Forms can link response data to Sheets; Maps/Photos/Meet do not serve the requested tabular response processing.
Required questions need a response before submission in their applicable form section; it does not verify truth or demand passwords/payment/source editing.
A per-option summary chart displays proportions; password lists, router photos and fonts do not summarize categorical results.
Clear, relevant, non-leading prompts improve survey quality; excessive compound questions, secret-only codes and forced agreement do not.

Publish the site's embedding change and verify form access; clarify with current official help that Forms also needs its own publication/respondent permissions. No RAM/domain change or response deletion is required.

Account restrictions require checking respondent permissions/sign-in settings; update rationale to include current Forms publication and separate permissions from Sites. Unrelated visual/file-count/logo-name changes cannot grant submission access.
The percentage describes recorded survey responses, not all Internet users, all national students or nonrespondents. Correct limits on inference; chart percentages may be rounded.

Looking at a preview alone does not test submission/permissions/destination storage; an actual controlled test response is needed. Preview itself may allow sending, so 'viewing' is not treated as a prohibition on submission.
Purpose, audience and core content are project-definition elements; PINs/credentials/display voltage are not appropriate group planning inputs.
Clear content and usable navigation are valid design goals; a tiny image-only site, blank-link destinations and invisible text do not satisfy them.
Themes provides coordinated colors/fonts/presentation; not MAC address changes, client OS installation or password disclosure.
Verified exact book example at printed p153: Tự nhiên, Kinh tế–Xã hội, Trắc nghiệm alongside Trang chủ. Other option sets are unrelated or confidential server artifacts.
Sites Preview approximates desktop/tablet/mobile layout sizes; it is not full real-device certification. Printer/password/memory controls do not provide responsive previews.
Relevant trustworthy legally reusable sources are appropriate; popularity/rumor/plagiarism are not substitutes for accuracy and rights.
Responsible person, deliverable and deadline support coordination; collecting secrets/history is unnecessary and invasive.
Publishing the updated design makes changes available to viewers; HDMI, CSV image suffixes and removing navigation cannot update the published site.
Broken navigation means the site is unfinished despite attractive images; guesses and public passwords do not cure functionality.
A shared palette gives consistent identity/experience; it does not transform question types, validate data or remove access requirements.
Check reuse permission/license and attribution as applicable; likes, photographers' passwords and keyboard names do not establish usage rights.
False: appearance does not discharge copyright obligations; rights remain an independent requirement.
False: changing the Drive project filename alone does not repair an incorrect destination link.
True: unintended form permissions can block feedback completion even when the embedding page loads.
True: prioritize permissions/navigation/authorized materials and retest before publication rather than adding visual polish alone.
